That is Ilya's table. Pass the order to him.
I brought out the order and brought the bill, he was just in a hurry.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'звать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'call, fetch', paired with 'звать'.

examples.text: Дядя Аркадий всё починит и позовёт.
examples.trans: Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.

examples.text: Позвать врача.
examples.trans: To call a doctor.

examples.text: Главное, чтобы она не позвала директора.
examples.trans: The main thing is that she does not call the director.

examples.trans: I was bringing a bribe to the institute, and he passed the exams himself.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'стоянный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('regular').
